_comment: The other half of colossus_speaker_taptoken_line.json: 26 life is one short of StartingLife() + 7, so TapTokenSourceLive closes the activation and the menu never offers it. CheckLine does not assert the life gate itself (its soundness rule: a line's own casts could in principle gain life first), so the honest grade is legal_not_enumerated -- the enumeration's own gate.
